summary: Routing matrix inertia during soft promote causes transparent variant sneak-back for dedicated tenant
description:
Issue summary: During a soft-promote canary for NebulaAI (dedicated pool) we observed a transient loss of model pin enforcement that resulted in a small fraction of requests being served by a transparent/degraded variant and subsequently lingering after the promote window.
Impact: ~0.7% of NebulaAI requests in us-east were served by the fallback variant for ~15 minutes, resulting in a measurable quality delta for customer QA tests and a spike in token cost for degraded quantized fallback.
Environment: production, dedicated (NebulaAI), us-east region, orchestrator v2.4.1, serving-runtime 1.9.3.
Steps to reproduce: 1) Start soft-promote (10% -> 40%) for redwood-3b-v2; 2) Initiate scheduled prewarm on dedicated pool; 3) Trigger tenant header rotation + edge-proxy reconnect; 4) Observe routing matrix entries and pin map during epoch boundary; expected: pinned sessions maintain variant, actual: some sessions flip to fallback and remain.
Logs/observables: Orchestrator epoch logs (trace ids: 9876a, 9876b) show commit window overlap; edge-proxy reconnects at same timestamps as prewarm handshake (see attached traces). Console shows cohort affinity decay events between 12:03:45 and 12:18:12 UTC.
Workaround: Manual pin refresh for affected tenant via console (force rebind) restored correct routing. Temporary mitigation: pause promote, drain edge-proxy connections, resume with extended commit window.
Notes: Customer reported via #support-nebula thread; billing/quality impact reported to CSM.
comments: Support (Maya Chen 2026-03-10): Customer ticket opened after they ran nightly QA and noticed degraded outputs. Provided initial ask and logs. SLA first response met.
Eng (Diego Ramirez 2026-03-11): Reproduced locally with a staging replay. Hypothesis: routing matrix apply step not honoring active pin set when an epoch boundary coincides with prewarm merge.
SRE (Anika Bose 2026-03-11): Observed edge-proxy reconnects causing partial route diff; prewarm mirror leaves shadow entries that are not properly garbage-collected until next full snapshot.
Support (Maya Chen 2026-03-11): Confirmed manual pin-refresh via console fixed customer session routing. Customer applied fix and confirmed reduction in quality delta.
Eng (Diego Ramirez 2026-03-12): Added a test-case for commit-window overlap in integration harness (PR linked). Working on a patch to make routing apply idempotent wrt pin sets.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Orchestrator commit window pick-up merges shadow mirror entries with stale affinity flags causing session-level routing to evaluate to fallback despite pin present.
Hypothesis 2: Edge-proxy reconnect produced duplicated session cookies with differing cohort fingerprints; routing matrix picks newest fingerprint which lacked pin metadata.
Mitigation verification: Manual rebind invalidates duplicate cookie and forces tenant routing to re-evaluate, which restored pinned variant.
Repro scope: Observed only on dedicated pools with prewarm-mirror enabled and orchestrator version <=2.4.1; not reproduced on hosted API in our tests.
resolution: In progress: patch proposed to make routing matrix apply idempotent relative to active pin sets. Short-term: recommend extending commit window and pausing prewarm mirrors for dedicated customers during soft-promotes. Follow-up action: backport patch to 2.4.x and run coordinated rollout; customer notified and scheduled maintenance window.
resolution_notes: Patch PR created and under review. Post-deploy verification plan includes telemetry checks for cohort-affinity-evictions and a canary test with NebulaAI in us-east.
